description: Use for "is my ad copy good?" or "why do viewers skip my video?". Returns a review of ads already running: first line, headline, call to action and link, with a score and specific issues, plus video ads from the last 7 days with hook rate, hold rate, where viewers drop off, a visual review of the frames and fix steps. For which ads are tired use get_ad_fatigue. Saved data from the latest review.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.

name: get_ad_copy_review
